source.name: UFC.com - Paramount announces landmark media rights deal with Zuffa Boxing
source.note: Long-term agreement making Paramount+ the exclusive home of Zuffa Boxing in the US, Canada and Latin America from January 2026, starting with 12 cards. The $100m-a-year figure is not in the release: The Guardian (Hauser, 28 Jan 2026) writes 'Paramount is believed to be paying Zuffa Boxing $100m a year for these 12 fight cards'.

note: Media-rights deal with the TKO-Sela joint venture; recorded at organisation level because the event-host shape has no schema yet.
